display_long_description:
Play table tennis in a realistic VR ping pong simulator. Every serve, loop, chop and smash responds to your swing and spin.

REALISTIC PHYSICS
The ball runs at 1,000 simulation steps per second, modelling gravity, air drag and spin. Topspin kicks forward, backspin checks the bounce and side spin curves shots.

CLIMB THE CAREER
Beat AI opponents, earn rewards and climb 12 leagues to face the King. Choose Beginner, Intermediate or Pro across 13 arenas.

5 GAME MODES
Play Quick Match, complete 11 training drills, test your aim in Lucky Shot, or practice in Free Practice with an adjustable ball machine, speed/RPM readouts and slow motion.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE
Collect 9 blades, 9 rubbers and 17 balls. Upgrades change speed, sweet spot and spin; open prize pods to earn rewards.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Play seated or standing, switch to left-handed mode, calibrate your grip and choose snap or smooth turning. Fully offline, with no ads, in-app purchases or paywalls. All rewards are earned in-game.
